messages.author: 565fb8e7abc16eb0
messages.subject: Re: producing trees with the say layout
parts:
Hello Dan,

Good question. I assume each sample has different a different set of taxa in the trees? There is currently no way of forcing a given taxon to be in a given place.  If the taxa are different, the placement will be different. One way you might be able to get around this would be to make sure all trees you want to have the same layout have the same set of taxa. You could include all taxa that appear in any of the samples for example. For a given sample, you can then use color/size to show that these taxa are absent (e.g. `node_color = ifelse(my_taxon_counts ==  0, "grey", my_stat_of_interest)`). I think you could also make the nodes/edges invisible by setting their color to `NA`, but they would still take up space in the layout, so that might not work for well for all data. Thats about all I can think of. At the moment, I cannot think of any easy change I could make to the package that would address this better, but I will keep it in mind. Hope this helps,

-Zach
